Container.Name: FITR
Container.Overview: Your wardrobe, shopped like a store. Photograph your clothes and FITR turns each piece into a shop-style listing, puts outfits together and suggests what to add or buy. Stores its database and photos in /data. A free Gemini key adds tagging and the stylist; an OpenAI or billed Gemini image key adds studio photos and try-on.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and photos. Keep it on the cache (cache-only share, or a /mnt/cache path): SQLite and the array's FUSE layer don't mix.

Config.Name: AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Signs session cookies; changing it signs everyone out. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

Config.Name: GEMINI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Free key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey for tagging photos, outfits and shop tips. Without it photos save untagged and outfits use colour rules.

Config.Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional, paid: studio photos and try-on with ChatGPT's image model. Key from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys with API credit.

Config.Name: GEMINI_MODEL
Config.Description: Text and vision model. Empty uses the built-in free-tier default.

Config.Name: OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL
Config.Description: OpenAI image model. Empty uses the built-in default.

Config.Name: OPENAI_IMAGE_QUALITY
Config.Description: low, medium or high: higher looks better and costs more per image.

Config.Name: GEMINI_IMAGE_MODEL
Config.Description: Gemini image model instead of OpenAI's; needs a billed Gemini key. Empty turns Gemini images off.

Config.Name: IMAGE_PROVIDER
Config.Description: With both image providers set up: openai or gemini, the default until a profile picks its own on the Me page.

Config.Name: STUDIO_ON_UPLOAD
Config.Description: With an image key every new piece is re-shot as a studio photo (one paid image each). Set to off to keep plain cut-outs.
